questions: Are you experiencing any tremors or shaking in your hands?
Do you have difficulty with fine motor tasks, such as writing or buttoning clothes?
Have you noticed any changes in your handwriting recently?
Do you experience muscle stiffness or rigidity?
Is the problem affecting both sides of your body equally?
Has anyone in your family been diagnosed with a neurological condition?
Do you have a history of head injuries?
Are you currently taking any medications?
orders: Perform the spiral drawing test (Archimedes spiral) on paper to assess for micrographia and tremor-induced irregularity.
Conduct a neurological examination focusing on the presence of resting versus action/postural tremor, and check for bradykinesia or rigidity.
Order blood tests including thyroid function tests (TSH, T4), complete blood count, comprehensive metabolic panel, and ceruloplasmin levels.
